enumDescriptions: Use omp (Oh My Pi) when found, otherwise pi
Oh My Pi: standalone binary, state in ~/.omp/agent
oh-my-pi-chater.backend.description: Agent CLI family to run in RPC mode. Reload the window after changing.

oh-my-pi-chater.cliPath.description: Path to the omp or pi executable (default: auto-detect from PATH). With backend "auto", a file named omp* selects omp.

oh-my-pi-chater.nodePath.description: pi backend only: Node.js binary used to run pi (default: node next to pi on PATH). Set this if native tools (memory_search) fail with NODE_MODULE_VERSION errors.

oh-my-pi-chater.thinkingLevel.description: Default thinking level for Pi agent responses

oh-my-pi-chater.autoApproveTools.description: Automatically approve tool executions without confirmation

oh-my-pi-chater.showAllModels.description: List every model the agent reports, including providers configured only via env vars or models.json/models.yml. Off: only providers you signed in to with /login (pi auth.json / omp credential store).

oh-my-pi-chater.favoriteModels.description: Starred models (`provider/id`) offered by the model chip under the chat input. Star or unstar models with the ☆ button in the full model picker (status bar model button or /model).

oh-my-pi-chater.contextUsageWarningThres.description: Show a warning when context usage exceeds this percentage of the context window

oh-my-pi-chater.promptRecommendedPackage.description: When Pi CLI sync is on, prompt to install recommended Pi packages (~/.pi/agent) if they are missing.

oh-my-pi-chater.autoInstallRecommendedPa.description: Install recommended Pi packages automatically on startup without asking (requires network/npm).

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.sttUrl.markdownDescription: Voice input: OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text endpoint, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8010/v1` (speaches / faster-whisper-server) or `https://api.openai.com/v1`. A bare host gets `/v1`; `/audio/transcriptions` is appended. Empty disables recording.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.sttModel.description: Voice input: transcription model id. Empty uses the first model the server lists at /models.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.language.description: Voice input: ISO-639-1 language hint (zh, en, …). Empty lets the model detect it per utterance.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.vadConfidence.description: Voice input: Silero VAD speech probability threshold. Lower it (e.g. 0.35) if quiet speech is missed; raise it if background noise gets transcribed.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.vadStopSecs.description: Voice input: pause (seconds) that ends an utterance and sends it to speech-to-text.

scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
